title: gg_vinceville
description: An original map made for Arms Race on the Over Strike 2 server: a village of small houses scattered over a big grassy field, with a barn and its hay loft, two houses with an upper floor, two ponds, haystacks, low stone walls and clusters of trees - close-range ambushes in and around every house. Rebuilt from scratch: one solid ground with no holes, every building one closed shape, no overlapping faces.
